name: ESOI Inside Other People's Running Code
vision_statement: Projects continuously use the best implementations without having to change what depends on them.
opportunities: The Python package can become a runtime dependency inside other people's production code, not only a tool run on a repository: selection at run time, graceful declarations of alternatives (decorators, for example) and embedding without forking. That is a creative space beyond selecting an implementation from a table in one repository.
solution_coherence: Runtime carries ESOI into other people's running programs. Implementation Selection serves each call with the declared implementation chosen by a per-call name, an override, the environment, the lock or the recorded default, and refuses an unknown name by listing the valid choices. Assemble Parts by Name builds whole programs from named parts in dependency order, choosing each part through Implementation Selection and checking what each part needs from its environment before it runs. Consumer Check lets a system built on the library show which library solution each of its parts serves and scores those parts with the library's cases, and it reads the pins that Implementation Selection keeps to show how far they trail the library.
